# O15: Morning rush

Market: US. Winner since 2026-09. Pain: time lost matching pairs in the morning.

## Hook (0–3 s)

Spoken: "It's 7am and you're on your knees looking under the bed for a sock"
On screen: "7am. One sock. Under the bed?"
Visual: person on the floor with a phone flashlight under the bed.

## Body (3–22 s)

"Mornings are already a race. The last thing you need is a sock hunt. With SockLock,
pairs stay snapped together from the dryer to the drawer to your feet. Grab one,
you have both."

Visual: kids running around, parent grabbing a connected pair from a drawer in one
move.

## CTA (22–28 s)

"Get five pairs for $29. Take the quiz to find your size."
On screen: "Find your size. 5 pairs for $29"
